# Ways to run it

[All categories](../README.md)

- [Desktop app](desktop-app.md): A Windows app that opens worlds straight from your .minecraft saves folder.
- [Docker web app](web-app.md): Run Map Editor on one machine and use it from any browser on your network.
- [Appliance image](appliance.md): A small Linux image that boots straight into the web app, for a VM or a spare PC.
- [Map Editor Deploy](deploy-app.md): One click to put Map Editor on Docker, VirtualBox or a USB drive, then the working link.
